description: Selectable gameplay pack for the opening shuttle encounter. On reload, choosing this pack gives the whitelisted shuttle-ambush runner a three-hostile contract and triples shuttle-raider health so the loaded pack is unmistakably active.

stages.objective: Survive first contact; sensors warn that all shuttle raiders are carrying triple-strength bio-signatures.
stages.title: Elite boarding signal detected

stages.objective: Survive the 3x-health raiders, defeat the elite boarding leader, and keep the shuttle on course for Haven orbit.
stages.title: Defeat the elite boarding leader

stages.objective: The triple-strength elite boarding leader is down and the shuttle remains on course for Haven orbit.
stages.title: Elite wave cleared

stages.objective: The shuttle ambush overwhelms the crew before the route stabilizes.
stages.title: Shuttle overrun

title: Opening Shuttle Ambush Elite Wave
